skirmish.module.main_menu.name: Main Menu
skirmish.module.main_menu.description: Skirmish's own title screen instead of vanilla's: animated space with a quasar, the Skirmish logo, a «Play on HolyWorld» button and server tips.
skirmish.module.main_menu.setting.quasar: A quasar with jets behind the menu and loading screens
skirmish.module.main_menu.setting.tips.t: Rotating HolyWorld tips in the menu and while loading
skirmish.module.pause_menu.name: Pause Menu
skirmish.module.pause_menu.description: Esc opens a Skirmish pause screen: session stats (kills, deaths, K/D, time) and quick buttons for the mod menu, HUD editor, waypoints, map and settings.
skirmish.module.pause_menu.setting.stats: Tiles with kills, deaths, K/D and time played
skirmish.module.transitions.name: Loading & Transitions
skirmish.module.transitions.description: Connecting, loading and saving screens in Skirmish style (space, logo, tip) instead of dirt and the chunk grid, and the world fades in after joining, dying or changing dimension.
skirmish.module.transitions.setting.load: Skirmish background on the connecting, loading and saving screens
skirmish.module.transitions.setting.fade: The world fades in from dark after loading
skirmish.menus.subtitle: a client for HolyWorld
skirmish.menus.tip.1: Every anarchy has a castle at 0 0 where loot shulkers spawn.
skirmish.menus.tip.2: The Sun Core at /warp pvp drops loot every 20–60 seconds.
skirmish.menus.tip.3: Within 12 blocks of the Sun Core you get coins or XP.
skirmish.menus.tip.4: The auto-mine at spawn refills every 10 minutes: /warp mine.
skirmish.menus.tip.5: Emerald ore protects 21×21, a netherite block 31×31.
skirmish.menus.tip.6: Do expensive trades through a guarantor: /garant.
skirmish.menus.tip.7: Right Shift opens the Skirmish menu.
skirmish.menus.tip.8: N reviews your last fight, K replays your death.
skirmish.menus.tip.9: Each Pandora Box chest lives 10 seconds — the first player takes up to 5 items.
skirmish.menus.tip.10: The unique ancient debris region only breaks to C4 and the Blast Wave.
skirmish.menus.tip.11: J saves the last seconds to «My replays».
skirmish.menus.tip.12: Castle shulkers: grey breaks 5 times, light blue 7, purple 12.
